title: CDCgov/neissflow pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for Neisseria gonorrhoeae (Ng) isolate genomic analysis

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with a header row.

controls.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the control samples.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

run_name.description: The name of the run, this will be in the final report filename.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

input_type.title: Input Type (REQUIRED)
input_type.description: Signify what filetypes are included in the samplesheet

only_fastq.description: Use flag if only FASTQ input is provided (entire pipeline can run with just FASTQ input)

only_fasta.description: Use flag if only FASTA contigs are provided (only snippy and the Phylogeny Subworkflow will run with this input)

fastq_w_fasta.description: Use flag if FASTQ and FASTA input are provided (entire pipeline can run with this input)

QC.description: True if running control samples through as well

skip_steps.title: Skip steps
skip_steps.description: Specify which sections of neissflow you would like to skip

skip_fastq_check.description: Skip FASTQ format check (only skip if your FASTQs have already been QCed)

skip_preprocess.description: Skip Preprocessing Subworkflow (only do this if your reads have already been preprocessed and QCed)

skip_species_id.description: Skip Species_ID Subworkflow (will skip Mash and FA19 coverage steps used to determine if a sample is NG)

skip_assembly.description: Skip Assembly Subworkflow (if you do this and do not provide assemblies, the AMR_Profiler Subworkflow will not run)

skip_assembly_qc.description: Skip Denovo Assembly QC script (do this if you are inputting non-shovill assemblies), QUAST will still run

species_id_parameters.title: Species ID parameters
species_id_parameters.description: Parameters for Species ID subworkflow (Mash and stats)

assembly_parameters.title: Assembly Parameters
assembly_parameters.description: Parameters for Assembly Subworkflow (shovill and QUAST)

downsample.description: Downsample reads to depth specified by depth parameter with shovill for assembly

depth.description: Depth for downsampling reads for assembly with shovill

FA19cg.description: path to FA19 FASTA file for QUAST ref

amr_profiler_parameters.title: AMR Profiler parameters
amr_profiler_parameters.description: Parameters for AMR Profiler Subworkflow (Snippy, depth, mlst, NGMASTER, BLAST)

amr_ref.description: Path to Genbank reference for AMR genes not found in FA19

loci.description: Path to file containing loci of AMR genes in FA19

default_amr.description: Path to list of AMR markers and their defaults

columns.description: Path to file containing the column order for the AMR report

strands.description: Path to file containing the strandedness of AMR genes in FA19

mtrR_mosaic_ref.description: Path to FASTA mtrR mosaic reference

pubmlst.description: path to local pubmlst database for mlst

blastdb.description: path to local blast database for mlst

dbname.description: prefix local blast database for mlst

ngstar.description: path to file with ngstar schemes

ngmast.description: path to file with ngmast schemes

ngmasterdb_version.description: latest download of NGMASTER database used for run

phylogeny_parameters.title: Phylogeny Parameters
phylogeny_parameters.description: Parameters for Phylogeny Subworkflow (snippy-core, Gubbins, snp-dists, RAxML, GoTree)

remove_ref.description: Remove reference from the core alignment produced by the Phylogeny Subworkflow (reference will not appear in generated tree)

snp_dist.description: SNP distance cutoff for direct connections used in outbreak detection algorithm

max_itr.description: Maximum Number of iterations for Gubbins to run with

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
